proposals.issue_title: Fragile Image Generation & Silent GHA Failures
proposals.current_pain_description: IP blocks (403 on AI Horde from GHA), Gemini 429 errors, and low-quality Pollinations outputs cause workflows to crash or generate unusable assets, wasting GHA runtime and manual review time.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a centralized 'ImageRouter' Python module with strict fallback logic: 1) Together AI (FLUX-schnell, free tier), 2) Cloudflare Workers AI (10k free daily neurons), 3) Runware (PAYG, capped at $0.0016/img), 4) Pollinations (last resort, with high-contrast prompt modifiers for line art). Include automatic retry decorators with exponential backoff on HTTP 429/500.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates 90% of workflow interruptions; guarantees high-quality FLUX outputs without manual retries.

proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo only has an Android phone. Manually downloading large raw assets from GitHub, extracting them, and uploading them to Redbubble/KDP/Cults3D via a mobile browser is extremely slow, tedious, and prone to browser crashes.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a 'MobileStaging' step at the end of every pipeline. This step: 1) Compresses assets into lightweight, mobile-optimized ZIPs (using WebP instead of heavy PNGs where possible for previews), 2) Generates a single, lightweight HTML or Markdown 'Copy-Paste Dashboard' containing optimized titles, descriptions, and tags, 3) Uploads these directly to a private Telegram channel via Bot API or a lightweight index page hosted on GitHub Pages, allowing Hugo to copy-paste metadata and download files with 1-tap on his phone.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces manual listing time on mobile from 15 minutes per product to under 3 minutes, maximizing Hugo's 10h/week constraint.

proposals.issue_title: Runware Budget Exhaustion & API Overspending Risk
proposals.current_pain_description: Using Runware PAYG without guardrails inside GitHub Actions loops can easily consume the entire €20 monthly budget in a single run if a loop gets stuck or if a pipeline is triggered repeatedly by automated cron jobs.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement an automated budget guardrail state file stored in the repository (`.github/budget_state.json`). Every API call to Runware must log its cost. If the cumulative monthly cost exceeds €18, the script automatically self-terminates, alerts Hugo via Telegram/GitHub Issue, and downgrades all active pipelines to the free Cloudflare/Together AI fallbacks.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents accidental overbilling on Hugo's credit card while maintaining unsupervised automation.

proposals.current_pain_description: AI-generated SVGs or automated bitmap-to-SVG tracings often contain millions of redundant nodes, overlapping paths, or unclosed loops. This results in rejected uploads on microstock platforms and broken files for laser-cutting/Cricut buyers, leading to bad reviews.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate `svgo` (SVG Optimizer) and a Python-based path-simplification utility (using `svgpathtools`) in the SVG pipeline. Automatically reject SVGs with path complexities above a specific threshold, or automatically run them through a headless vector-cleanup script before packaging.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Ensures 100% commercial-grade vector files that pass automated platform audits and prevent buyer refunds.

proposals.issue_title: Silent Trademark Infringement in AI Metadata
proposals.current_pain_description: Generating hundreds of titles, tags, and quotes via LLMs (Gemini) carries a high risk of listing trademarked terms (e.g., Disney characters, brand names, famous quotes), which can lead to immediate store bans on KDP and Redbubble.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add an offline validation step utilizing a Python-based trademark dictionary (e.g., using a compiled JSON blacklist of common high-risk words like 'Super Bowl', 'Harry Potter', etc.) combined with a free, lightweight check against the USPTO/TESS API or a scraped public database before metadata is written to the staging files.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Protects seller accounts from permanent bans, securing the long-term equity of Hugo's business.

proposals.current_pain_description: Pipelines run in complete isolation. High-quality assets created for a coloring book are never reused for SVG packs, digital stickers, or physical POD apparel, missing out on 5x additional revenue streams per generated asset.
proposals.proposed_fix: Establish a post-generation 'AssetDistributor' script. When a high-resolution coloring page or illustration is successfully generated and approved, this script automatically: 1) Saves it as a high-res PNG (for KDP), 2) Vectorizes it to SVG (for Etsy/SVG pack), 3) Centers it on transparent backgrounds for apparel (Redbubble), 4) Bundles it into a 'printable PDF' package. All formats are zipped and staged in one single mobile-friendly manifest.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies listings and revenue channels per hour worked by reusing the exact same AI outputs.
